=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81-87, 134-136, 303, 392, 425-428 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The PR removes the structured Semble telemetry and timing helper, replacing it with a bare print and dropping the success-path log line.
  WHY: That breaks existing stderr contract tests and removes chunk/byte/ms observability from overflow queries.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134-136, 392-397 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: semble_max_chunks now reaches --top-k without the prior [1, 20] clamp.
  WHY: Passing 0 or very large values can yield empty or unnecessarily expensive Semble queries.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-126, 223-230 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The cached ISSUE_META_FILE is no longer validated against the current issue number.
  WHY: A stale metadata file can be reused for the wrong issue, feeding incorrect labels and body text into the diagnose prompt.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-381 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble-backed diagnose context pipeline was removed from the prompt builder.
  WHY: The diagnose prompt loses the bounded Semble context enrichment that was previously used to ground post-Codex failure diagnosis.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:299-317 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: install_semble.sh and semble_helpers.sh are staged into scripts/ but never appended to _fetched_scripts.
  WHY: The generated scripts/.gitignore will miss those files, so consumer repos can accidentally commit the fetched support scripts.

- scripts/render_prompt.sh:38-62 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The placeholder replacement and unresolved-placeholder guard only catch standalone {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} lines.
  WHY: An inline placeholder would pass through unrendered and evade the guard, letting the raw token reach the prompt.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:124-133 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: append_semble_query_section() is defined but never called.
  WHY: The function is dead code, so it only adds maintenance surface and can mislead future edits.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:440, 465 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_BIN is exported to GITHUB_ENV twice.
  WHY: The second export is redundant because GITHUB_ENV persists across steps; reviewers disagreed only on how minor it is.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:26-73 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble query-text helper logic is duplicated instead of being shared with the orchestration script.
  WHY: Duplicate implementations can drift over time and make Semble query changes harder to keep consistent.

- tests/test_judge_semble_prefetch_contract.py:1-140 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new contract test file is not referenced by any CI workflow allowlist.
  WHY: CI can miss regressions even if the test passes locally, so the new contract is not actually enforced in automation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:81, 134-136, 303, 392, 425-428 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR removes import time, _log_semble_event(), _normalize_semble_max_chunks(), and SEMBLE_MAX_CHUNKS_CAP=20, and replaces the structured overflow telemetry with a bare print.
  WHY: The existing contract test expects the SEMBLE_QUERY stderr format, and production loses chunk/byte/ms observability.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:115-126, 223-230 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: issue_meta_matches_issue() was removed, so the cached ISSUE_META_FILE is only checked for being non-empty.
  WHY: A stale metadata file can be reused for the wrong issue and feed incorrect labels/body text into the diagnose prompt.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:124-133 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: append_semble_query_section() is defined but never called anywhere in the script.
  WHY: It is dead code and only adds maintenance surface.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:134-136, 392 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The normalization function that clamped semble_max_chunks into [1, 20] was removed.
  WHY: Passing 0 yields empty results and very large values make the overflow query unnecessarily expensive.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:344-381, 376-381 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: build_diagnose_semble_query() and its injection into the diagnose prompt were removed.
  WHY: The implement-diagnose prompt loses the Semble-grounded context enrichment that helped diagnose post-Codex failures.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:302-315 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: install_semble.sh and semble_helpers.sh are installed into scripts/ but never appended to _fetched_scripts.
  WHY: The generated scripts/.gitignore will not include those files, so consumer repos can accidentally commit them.

- scripts/render_prompt.sh:41-44, 57-60 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The placeholder replacement case and unresolved-placeholder guard only match standalone lines.
  WHY: An inline placeholder like Context: {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}} would pass through unrendered and evade the guard.

- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:440 and 465 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: SEMBLE_BIN is exported to GITHUB_ENV twice.
  WHY: The second export is harmlessly redundant because the workflow environment already persists across steps.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:43-50 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: append_semble_query_text_section() is defined identically in two scripts.
  WHY: It is a maintenance-only duplication; there is no runtime failure today.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
